row.title: Generated files follow main in unstick; practical-solutions settings as code; auto-merge on
row.body: UNSTICK-1 regenerated generated files into PR branches after merging main, which made them diverge from main again and conflict on the next bot commit (#935). scripts/unstick_prs.sh now sets every file in seed/worker/src/generated.js to main's copy; main regenerates after merge. Allow auto-merge was off on both repos although github/org-settings.json declared it; set on both through the owner's signed-in browser and verified through the API (allow_auto_merge true). practical-solutions added to github/org-settings.json so the applier and platformaudit keep it. Tests pass.

title: Generated files follow main in unstick; practical-solutions settings as code; auto-merge on
